name: The brood-sac, the Chorus carrier (The Chorus)
shape_ref_yaw_note: null until measured: stage 3 measures the long axis (common.shape_ref_yaw, ai_align); read the overlay, then write the value here (plus 180 if the bow came out aft)
notes: Built from the build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/chorus_C14/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/chorus_C14.py, the Chorus kit tools/blender/kits/chorus/; issue 1155). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the ship length (LENGTH 16.5, the Carrier class length) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. game_code B22_11 is the chorus|Carrier folder the game picks (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old A4 hull there, copied aside first. bake stack: the shared Chorus paint stack tools/blender/kits/chorus/stack.py, on main since PR 1308 (issue 1291, round G; PR 1083 was superseded). Stage 3 does not trace or tune a sheet hull; it fits the concept camera and reports the outline.
